text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ouch...
Hauu, my head suddenly hurts so much...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I suddenly got a headache...
I don't think it's a cold, though...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I haven't even tripped today, so I really
can't think of any reason... Hmmm...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ouch...!
It's starting to hurt again~.
choice_data_list: Could it be that you're just overthinking things?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, whenever I'm deep in thought,
it feels like my head starts to hurt...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: "Which means... if I just don't think about anything...? A-All right... Don't think, don't think—"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ugh... But I really need to reflect properly on what happened today...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah, ow-ow-ow...!!
I-It looks like not thinking about it is impossible...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unable to stop overthinking, Meisho Doto
continued to suffer from a nagging headache...
